Yeah exactly. And at least Mike and I and in a way Barry, we learned on the job and Sanborn, you know we were semi-schooled. You know there were big holes and gaps because I don’t think any of us really — when I went to Indiana it wasn’t really a developed jazz program yet. I was in the big band, really that was it. I took a traditional theory course but the guy, I don’t think he was a good teacher. I didn’t get much out of it and he flunked half the class, including me. So I learned from books and from just…
